## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes

- [ ] `npm run build` passes

      honest; nothing was widened from `write` to `read` for convenience)
- [ ] Updated `AGENTS.md` if I changed behavior agents rely on (commands, flows, gotchas)
